features: Completes Phase 3 of the multi-discipline BDC scoring rollout for Bachata and Salsa while keeping one shared BDC ID
Restores the original proven scoring core exactly after the interrupted Phase 3 attempt; admin/scoring/core.php matches known-good blob ea9a05219846458a5be26453a01af386c89c0068
Adds Dance Style selection when creating scoring rounds with Bachata as default and Salsa limited to Novice, Intermediate and Advanced
Persists dance_style on new scoring rounds and preserves the same discipline when callbacks advance to Semifinal or Final
Keeps Bachata Rising, Bachata Open and Bachata Invitational restricted to Bachata only
Separates Registration Desk links by Event, Dance Style and Division so Salsa and Bachata can run independently in the same event
Makes Registration Desk competitor search and eligibility discipline aware; Salsa role, division, points and competition history no longer read Bachata data
Creates or reuses a Salsa discipline profile under the competitor's existing BDC ID when appropriate
Makes direct Salsa scoring-entry validation use Salsa-only points and progression history
Separates test scoring deletion by dance style so deleting Salsa Novice cannot remove Bachata Novice scoring from the same event
Adds an isolated Salsa publication workflow using the existing Super Admin approval model and the same BDC tier and point allocation rules as Bachata
Writes approved Salsa point transactions and participant results explicitly with dance_style=salsa so Bachata and Salsa points cannot mix
Publishes separate Salsa Heats, Final and Points repository files with Salsa-specific filenames to avoid overwriting Bachata documents
Keeps the established Bachata scoring calculation engine and Relative Placement calculator unchanged
No manual Staging or Production deployment performed; automatic deployment status must be verified separately
